ValidationRule.description: A deal priced below its Margin Floor can't move to a proposal stage (50%+ probability) or Closed Won until Pricing Review approves it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Below_Margin_Floor__c, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Margin_Approval_Status__c, "Approved")), ISCHANGED(StageName), OR(IsWon, Probability >= 0.5) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Estimated Margin is below the floor for this contract type. Submit the opportunity for Pricing Review approval before moving it to proposal or Closed Won.
